content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

Selling Notion templates for crypto means bypassing conventional payment platforms that charge exorbitant fees and require extensive verification processes. Platforms like Gumroad take up to 10% from each sale, while the NOWPayments solution offers a mere 0.5% fee. This fundamental shift allows you to create a sustainable income stream without losing a significant portion of your earnings to transaction fees. By adopting a sovereign commerce stack, you gain autonomy over your sales process, ensuring that you’re not dependent on third-party platforms that may lock you out.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure for selling digital products without traditional payment processors consists of several components working seamlessly together. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your store, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script manage backend logic for automated delivery. Supabase or Google Sheets function as your order storage, ensuring data integrity and ownership. This architecture not only streamlines operations but also enhances security and efficiency, enabling you to focus on creating quality Notion templates without worrying about payment processing reliability.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where access to payment processors is limited or non-existent. If you’re a designer, educator, or developer looking to monetize your Notion templates, this architecture empowers you to take control of your sales. By utilizing cryptocurrency payments, you can cater to a global audience while avoiding the challenges posed by traditional payment methods. This model is built for those who prioritize ownership and want to establish a direct relationship with their customers.
Reduce your transaction fees from 10% to 0.5% with NOWPayments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The Sovereign stack comprises various components that integrate seamlessly to create a powerful sales platform. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve as your hosting solution, providing a stable foundation for your online store. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle the backend tasks, ensuring that deliveries are automated and efficient. Supabase or Google Sheets acts as your database, while NOWPayments facilitates seamless cryptocurrency transactions. Each part is essential for creating a robust platform that eliminates dependence on traditional payment systems.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, sign up for GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages to host your store. Next, use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate the order processing. Set up Supabase or Google Sheets to manage your orders. Integrate NOWPayments for handling crypto transactions, ensuring you have a seamless payment experience for your customers. Finally, load your Notion templates and make your store live. With the Sovereign Blueprint ($47), you’ll have all the documentation and support needed to deploy your stack effectively.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell ebooks online without PayPal or Stripe by utilizing a cryptocurrency payment solution like NOWPayments. This allows you to handle transactions securely while minimizing fees. The infrastructure provided by tools like GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Workers ensures your digital products are delivered automatically without relying on traditional payment platforms.
Gain full ownership of your revenue and customer data without platform restrictions.

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
